File utilities and extension hooks

Handle opening specific attachments from Telegram UI.

Register and remove

FilesController.register(info) and unregister(ext, secret) are the module-level equivalents. Duplicate registrations raise ExtensionAlreadyRegistered. The host removes registrations when the plugin stops.

Callback and access

The callback receives OnClickArgs with the opening place, Java File, file name, message, activity and parent fragment when available. file_name uses the original document name when Telegram provides it. Optional get_icon returns a Drawable used by the document list. The hook needs ui, messages.observe and an authorized account. Protected and secret attachments stay on the standard path.

File helpers

get_plugins_dir() resolves the calling plugin’s data directory. Use read_file, read_file_bytes, write_file, write_file_bytes and list_dir for common storage operations.
